biggest_catch: You must live at the NIH Clinical Center in Bethesda, MD for two full 7-day inpatient stays (14 confined days) plus follow-ups, and you only get the $1,600 after completing everything.
catches: Must meet healthy-adult criteria through NIH's screening process; not everyone qualifies

Medical risks: the study involves controlled inhalation exposures to environmental agents, blood draws, lung-function testing, and skin tests; ask the study team about side effects and risks at informed consent
You are confined to the hospital research unit for two 7-day inpatient stays — 14 days away from work/family
Paid only upon completion of the full study ('You may be compensated $1,600 upon completion of study'); no amount for partial participation is stated
Location-specific: NIH Clinical Center, Bethesda, Maryland — no travel reimbursement stated

c3.evidence: Official study page limits eligibility to healthy adults 18-80 ('Who May Be Eligible: Healthy adults ages 18 to 80 years may be eligible'). No fee to participate stated or implied.

c4.evidence: Compensation ($1,600 on completion), eligibility (healthy adults 18-80), and visit structure (two 7-day inpatient stays + follow-up outpatient visits) all stated on the official study page.

eligibility: Healthy adults 18-80 years old; must meet the healthy-adult criteria through NIH's recruitment screening process
notes: One provider/site = one route. Anchored on the currently-recruiting environmental-exposures study (#002257-I, Dr. Hirsh Komarow / NIAID). Other NIH Clinical Center studies are separate opportunities under the same provider route.
numeric_basis: payout from official study page ($1,600 flat, paid on completion; min 0 since conditional on completing full study); time: 14 inpatient days with active time estimated at ~12-14 awake (non-sleep) hours per day (14x720=10,080 min to 14x840=11,760 min) plus 2 follow-up outpatient visits (~60-90 min each). The dominant commitment is the 14 confined days.

payout_value_note: Flat $1,600 stipend paid upon completion of the full study; paid in USD.

steps: Go to the official NIH Clinical Center recruitment page for study 002257-I and review the eligibility and visit schedule
Contact the NIH Clinical Center Office of Patient Recruitment at 833-JOIN-NIH or ccopr@nih.gov to express interest
Complete pre-screening (questionnaire and medical review) to confirm you meet the healthy-adult criteria
Pass the NIH recruitment screening process to confirm you meet the healthy-adult criteria
Complete the first 7-day inpatient hospital stay in the research unit
Complete the second 7-day inpatient stay 4 to 6 weeks later, plus the two follow-up outpatient visits
Receive the $1,600 stipend upon completion of the full study
timing: Two 7-day inpatient hospital stays at the NIH Clinical Center (spaced 4-6 weeks apart) plus follow-up outpatient visits 2 weeks after each stay; samples (blood, urine, skin, stool, mouth swab) and lung-function/smell/skin testing throughout.
